articles.title: Amazon makes it easier to buy what you see on Prime Video - TechCrunch
articles.description: Amazon is expanding shopping integrations across Prime Video, letting viewers discover products tied to thousands of shows, movies, and live sports through X-Ray, its shopping app, and a new Lens-powered “Shop the Scene” feature.
